description: Allow non-browser clients on SRE MCP, media and read-only state paths
expression: (http.host eq "sre-mcp.zacgamedev.com" and http.request.uri.path eq "/mcp") or (http.host eq "sre-review.zacgamedev.com" and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/media/") or (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/state" and http.request.method eq "GET")))
